subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin mentioned javelins and demonstrated a Sharpshooter's instinct, trained in and applied to range, with the intent to hold the gap during the next engagement while others tied knots and made things into fire.
source_quote: Thorin mentioned javelins. He had apparently acquired some facility with thrown weapons — a Sharpshooter's instinct, trained in, applied to range — and he wanted something with reach for the next engagement.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum made a sound, and together with Thorin, found 'the Ember Grapple' very funny — though it is unclear who specifically reacted.
source_quote: Grygum made a sound. Thorin said something about 'the Ember Grapple.' Someone — possibly Thorin again, possibly Grygum, it is hard to tell when they are both making noise — found this very funny.

subject: The Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard charges in with fire and flash and the announcement of itself — a collective entity described as acting with intent and presence.
source_quote: The Ember Vanguard charges in with fire and flash and the announcement of itself.

subject: The Ember Grapple
fact: The Ember Grapple holds something still until there is nothing left to hold — a collective entity described as acting with intent and presence, possibly the same party as the Ember Vanguard but from a different perspective.
source_quote: The Ember Grapple holds something still until there is nothing left to hold.

subject: tunnel traversal
fact: The group mentally replayed the tunnel traversal — the distance traveled, the pace, and the absence of obvious threats ahead — establishing a tactical baseline for the next engagement.
source_quote: I had run the tunnels in my head — the distance we had traveled, the pace, the absence of obvious threats immediately ahead.

subject: javelins
fact: Javelins were acquired by Thorin, who developed facility with them as thrown weapons — a Sharpshooter's instinct trained and applied to range.
source_quote: Thorin mentioned javelins. He had apparently acquired some facility with thrown weapons — a Sharpshooter's instinct, trained in, applied to range.

subject: the Ember Grapple
fact: The name 'the Ember Grapple' was noted and accepted as accurate — a designation for a faction or entity whose function is to immobilize until nothing remains.
source_quote: The Ember Grapple. I let it settle. As names go, I have heard worse.

subject: identity of the Ember entities
fact: It is unresolved whether the Ember Vanguard and the Ember Grapple are the same party described from two different positions — a foreshadowed ambiguity in factional identity.
source_quote: Both accurate. Possibly the same party described from two different positions in the room.

subject: the throne room
fact: The Pudding King was dragged through his own throne room — a location associated with a violent or symbolic act of subjugation.
source_quote: I dragged the Pudding King through his own throne room.

subject: next engagement
fact: There would be no long rest before whatever came next — a temporal anchor marking imminent action with no recovery window.
source_quote: There would be no long rest before whatever came next.
